propositions: A signed verdict must stamp not only the model string but also the provider identity, endpoint host, tier (first_class or best_effort), and effective capabilities so consumers can distinguish verdicts by their true source.
The new provider_provenance object must be additive-only and optional for backward compatibility, allowing legacy readers to ignore it and older payloads to load without migration.

Provenance assembly must reuse the single capabilities record already computed per run rather than recomputing it, and must use urlparse().hostname to exclude credentials from the persisted endpoint_host.

All five finalize_verdict call sites across plan-review and completion gates must thread the already-assembled provider_provenance record from runner.run() through to the verdict dict so the sidecar payload carries it end-to-end.

Security tests must verify that credential material from base_url and api_key never appears in the persisted sidecar payload, and backward-compatibility tests must verify that legacy payloads lacking provider_provenance still load and verify correctly.
